bioFailed: The biography could not be created. Check the PDF and try again.
bioGenerateHelp: Upload a PDF about the artist. We draft a biography for you to review and edit. Scanned PDFs without text cannot be read.
bioGenerateTitle: Draft the biography from a PDF
bioNeedsSavedEvent: Save the event first, then you can generate a biography from a PDF here.
bioReady: The draft biography is in the field above. Review it, then save.
bioWaiting: Creating the draft. This usually takes under a minute.
deleteDraftDescription: This permanently deletes the draft performance {{when}} of "{{title}}" with its map and tickets. Shared venue templates are kept. This cannot be undone.
deleteEventDescription: This permanently deletes "{{title}}", all of its draft performances, its poster and artist biography files. This cannot be undone.
discardDescription: The pending changes to "{{title}}" are deleted. Buyers keep seeing the live version.
draftSaved: Changes saved as a draft. Submit them for review when they are ready.
editHelp: Your changes stay private until TicketBox approves them. Buyers keep seeing the live version meanwhile.
guestsLockedBody: Guest lists belong to a released performance. Once this performance is released you can import its guest list here and check guests in at the door.
legacyHelp: This concert was created before the new event workspace. You can follow its guests, orders and reports here. TicketBox support makes changes to it.
legacyNoTickets: No ticket types are set up.
posterAfterSave: The poster is uploaded when you save the event.
posterBadType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
posterFailedAfterCreate: The event was saved, but the poster could not be uploaded. Add it from Event details.
posterHelp: Buyers see the poster as a 3:4 card and a 16:9 banner cropped from the same image. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB, with the main subject in the middle.
posterStaged: Poster added to your pending changes.
posterStagedHint: A new poster is part of your pending changes and is shown to buyers only after approval.
posterTooLarge: The poster must be no larger than 5 MB.
queueEmpty: No content changes in this state.
requestChangeBody: To change "{{title}}", ask TicketBox support. Tell them which concert and what you would like to change.
requestChangeNoContact: Ask your TicketBox contact to make the change.
statusHelpChangesRequested: TicketBox asked for changes. Edit the details and submit them again.
statusHelpDrafting: Your changes are saved but not submitted. Buyers still see the live version.
statusHelpRejected: TicketBox did not approve these changes. Edit and resubmit them, or discard them.
statusHelpSubmitted: TicketBox is reviewing your changes. Buyers keep seeing the live version until they are approved.
statusLiveHelp: Buyers see this version. Changes you make are reviewed by TicketBox before buyers see them.
withdrawn: Changes withdrawn. You can keep editing.
bioReplacePrompt: The event already has a biography. Replace it with this generated draft?
decisionStale: This revision changed while you were reviewing it. The latest version is shown; review it again before deciding.
guestsNotAvailableTitle: Guest import is not available yet.
guestsNotAvailableBody: Guest lists can be imported after this concert is released. Batch history will appear here then.
